text.to: S04E10 Its Been a Strange Ride

body.summary: A gothic animated series adapting Castlevania III. Lisa Tepes, a would-be doctor, talks her way into Dracula's castle and becomes his wife; the Church burns her as a witch, and Dracula gives Wallachia one year before unleashing an army of night creatures. Trevor Belmont, disgraced last son of the monster-hunting family, pairs with Speaker magician Sypha Belnades and Dracula's half-vampire son Alucard to storm the castle and kill him. Later seasons scatter the survivors into power struggles: Carmilla's Styrian sisters scheme to build a livestock empire from Hector the Forgemaster, Isaac travels to take revenge and becomes a builder, and Saint Germain tries to open the Infinite Corridor. ||Trevor dies defeating Death but is spat back out of the Corridor alive; the survivors found a village called Belmont.||

arcs.summary: Lisa is burned; Dracula gives Wallachia a year, then unleashes the night hordes; Trevor, Sypha and Alucard unite to kill him.
Dracula's war council splinters as Carmilla engineers a Styrian coup and betrayals pile up.
Hector is dragged to Styria and bound by slave rings; Carmilla's expansion plan strains her sisters.
Isaac sails for revenge, buries and rebuilds a desert city, and reaches Styria to kill Carmilla.
Saint Germain manipulates the Lindenfeld monks and Targoviste vampires to open the Corridor and forge the Rebis; Death reveals itself; Trevor dies and returns.

leashes, collars and caged pets (Hector, Lenore's 'good boy')
whips, hammers and knives as instruments of forging and killing
salt, holy water and running water as vampire lore debated
the Belmont Hold as archive and inheritance
the Rebis and alchemical signs (sulphur, Saturn, scythe)
sunrise and daylight as death to vampires
themes: vampires given free will and redemption arcs
loyalty, betrayal and the cost of power
knowledge as inheritence torn between science, church and magic

notable_scenes.summary: Lisa demands Dracula teach her medicine; she wins him over by wanting to make the world better.
Trevor, Sypha and Alucard meet under Gresit and nearly fight before Alucard names himself.
Alucard and Dracula fight in a flooded room; Dracula lets the killing stroke land.
Lenore makes Hector swear loyalty with the slave rings while he is inside her.
Isaac preaches a future to his night creatures over berries instead of blood.
Saint Germain is revealed as the vessel of Death in Alucard's childhood room.
Trevor kills Death with his dagger; Sypha finds the corridor and Trevor comes back alive.
The survivors plan a village called Belmont.
